facts.fact: The e-Government Authority's roadmap states, under the current situation, that a total of 265 ministries, departments, agencies and local government authorities were connected on the dedicated government communication network, GovNet; it gives no date for the figure, so the roadmap's own date of February 2024 is used.

The e-Government Authority gives one combined figure of 265 MDAs and LGAs connected to GovNet and does not say how many of the 265 are local government authorities, nor the total number of authorities; the figure is undated and the roadmap's date of February 2024 is used.

The roadmap, dated February 2024 and covering the next five years, sets out the e-Government Strategy 2022-2027 strategies under its connected-government objective, among them to expand coverage of GovNet to all LGA and MDA facilities and service delivery points.

The e-Government Authority, a public institution set up under the e-Government Act 2019, describes GovNet as the dedicated government communication network on which MDAs and LGAs are connected and issues the roadmap for it; undated in the text, so the roadmap's date of February 2024 is used.
